## What I've Built

### IT Support Diagnostics
- System: Ticketing system with an automated diagnostic engine.
- Purpose: Reads signals from PCs, determines likely root causes across 28+ categories, and safely resolves low-risk issues with rollback capability.
- Stack: C#, .NET 8, WPF, Entity Framework Core, MySQL, YAML rules, MSIX.
- Status: In use today.

### Inventory Valuation
- System: Month-end accounting automation for a manufacturer.
- Purpose: Calculates inventory valuation according to the IAS 2 international accounting standard and generates audit-ready Excel workbooks.
- Stack: Python, MySQL, openpyxl, Streamlit, Tkinter.
- Status: In use today.

## Background & Story
- 3 years of rigorous civil services preparation with a focus on humanities and psychology.
- Engineering approach: Observe how people work, find the root cause slowing them down, and build software that makes the right way the easy way.
- AI workflow: Human-in-the-loop engineering with AI coding agents (Antigravity, pi, Ollama), setting rules, architecture, and verification.
